svg.title: AI SALES AGENT — Converts inbound B2B emails into approval-ready quotations with multi-agent orchestration. Key facts: 5 agents: intake → match → price → quote → send; Hybrid pgvector product matching; Mandatory human approval gate. Stack: Python, FastAPI, Next.js, PostgreSQL, pgvector. Status: PHASE 1 · PUBLIC.
